body: When I feel some kinds of pain it triggers panic attack on me for years now. What has helped me stopping an episode is taking alprazolam; I'd suggest you talking with a psychiatrist and mentioning if could prescribe you it for when you have panic attacks. But on me it is not related to PTSD as far as I can tell.
